2609.02056.title: HyGRAIL: Cost-Aware and Evidence-Grounded Scientific Hypothesis Discovery over Knowledge Graphs
2609.02056.paper_summary: Scientific knowledge graphs organize entities and relations extracted from scientific literature, but they remain inherently incomplete. Missing typed links in such graphs can therefore represent plausible scientific hypotheses, such as unexplored associations between materials and applications. However, scientific hypothesis discovery is challenging because true discoveries are extremely sparse among typed candidate pairs: graph neural networks (GNNs) are efficient but unreliable for ambiguous cases, while large language models (LLMs) are knowledgeable but too costly to apply exhaustively and are not naturally grounded in graph structures. We propose HyGRAIL, a cost-aware and evidence-grounded framework that combines heterogeneous GNN triage with LLM-based hypothesis review. HyGRAIL first uses a GNN to score candidate hypotheses and identify a validation-calibrated ambiguous region, routing only graph-uncertain cases to LLM review. For each routed hypothesis, HyGRAIL retrieves node-level associations and multi-hop relational paths from the knowledge graph (KG), then converts this structured evidence into natural language through template-based or LLM-based naturalization. An LLM review agent finally judges each hard hypothesis using the naturalized evidence and validation-selected decision criteria. On MatKG, HyGRAIL achieves the best F1 score of 0.429, improving over the strongest prior baseline by 0.242 F1 points and over the GNN-only baseline by 0.322. Meanwhile, GNN triage reduces the LLM call rate by 54.36% on average. Ablation studies further show that retrieved graph evidence is crucial for reliable hypothesis verification and that compact, two-sided evidence is more effective than simply increasing retrieval quantity.
2609.02056.paper_summary_zh: 科學知識圖譜組織從科學文獻中提取的實體和關係，但它們本質上仍然不完整。這些圖譜中缺失的類型鏈接因此可以代表合理的科學假設，例如材料與應用之間未探索的關聯。然而，科學假設的發現具有挑戰性，因為在類型候選對中，真正的發現極為稀疏：圖神經網絡（GNN）在模糊情況下效率高但不可靠，而大型語言模型（LLM）知識豐富但應用成本過高，且不自然地基於圖結構。我們提出了HyGRAIL，一個成本意識和證據基礎的框架，結合異質GNN篩選和基於LLM的假設審查。HyGRAIL首先使用GNN對候選假設進行評分，並識別經驗驗證調整的模糊區域，僅將圖不確定的案例路由到LLM審查。對於每個路由的假設，HyGRAIL從知識圖譜（KG）檢索節點級關聯和多跳關係路徑，然後通過基於模板或基於LLM的自然化將這些結構化證據轉換為自然語言。最後，LLM審查代理使用自然化的證據和經驗驗證選擇的決策標準來評判每個困難的假設。在MatKG上，HyGRAIL達到了最佳F1分數0.429，比最強的先前基線提高了0.242 F1點，並且比僅使用GNN的基線提高了0.322。同時，GNN篩選平均減少了54.36%的LLM調用率。消融研究進一步顯示，檢索的圖證據對於可靠的假設驗證至關重要，而緊湊的雙面證據比僅僅增加檢索數量更有效。
